author: Bobby Grayson
description: While designing the numeric token invariant I expected to need Step.prefix (FIFO). Instead the a+qn=w equation handles the out-of-order case. FIFO matters for liveness (the token is not lost), not for mutual exclusion.
title: Invariant does not need FIFO: the non-FIFO case (acquire h while h still holder) is absorbed by a+qn=w. Suggests many BEAM protocols are FIFO-agnostic for safety
